hooks.text: 不同氏族护甲、武器与失落神器可拼出专属战斗流派
hooks.excerpt: Choose the precision-crafted armor of Yuheng Clan artisans, the ocean-forged blades of Shark Tribe warriors, or wield the lost artifacts of ancient mages. Customize a one-of-a-kind combat style to overcome diverse battlefield challenges.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 遗物可跨局保存并在出发前自由携带，形成搜寻—战斗—撤离成长循环
hooks.excerpt: The mysterious Relics collected during your adventures, unlike in-run Equipment, can be preserved outside of individual runs. Before each adventure begins, you may freely select collected Relics to bring into your run, forging your unique starting advantages and growth paths.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 三人合作加入装备交易、仇恨管理与队友援助机制
hooks.excerpt: The game supports up to 3 players in co-op. We've designed Equipment trading, aggro systems, teammate assistance mechanics, and more.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
